description: Decode EVM transaction calldata before signing: finds the function signature (signature DB, verified by re-encoding to reject selector collisions), decodes all arguments, expands multicall batches, and warns about unlimited token approvals, approve-all-NFTs, permits, ownership changes and upgrades. Works for any EVM chain. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).

data.description: hex calldata (selector + ABI-encoded args), max 16 KB
